final: SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rental_price_per_day, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) / (SELECT AVG(rating_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS rating_avg FROM film GROUP BY rating)) AS per_day_ratio_to_rating_average FROM film GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating
